terra.problem: “Priests wear special clothes” includes the people’s gifts for the garments, which are not in Exodus 28:43. Cite Exodus 28:42–43 and 35:19–22, or remove the sentence about the gifts.
“The cloud fills the house” includes details from 1 Kings 8:11. Change the passage to 1 Kings 8:10–11.

“Hezekiah’s time: neglect” could suggest that burnt offerings were made inside the Holy Place room. The bronze altar was outside it. Clarify that the verse speaks of service in the sanctuary more broadly. To identify Hezekiah as the speaker, also include 2 Chronicles 29:3–7.
“Leave the holy clothes behind” concerns the holy area and priestly chambers in Ezekiel’s vision, not specifically the Holy Place room. It does not belong on this card as a moment at that room.
“Incur guilt” and “ministering” may be difficult at a fifth-grade reading level. Consider “become guilty” and “serving.”
